name: 连接信息（示例）
description: 验证当前数据库、账号及服务器时间；不是视频上传检查。
sql: SELECT DATABASE() AS 数据库, CURRENT_USER() AS 当前账号, VERSION() AS 数据库版本, NOW() AS 服务器时间

name: 参数查询（示例）
description: 演示参数化查询。请由实施人员替换为已经验证的业务 SQL。
sql: SELECT %(start_time)s AS 开始时间, %(end_time)s AS 结束时间

name: 煤矿视频与刻录机通道对应
description: 按视频编码匹配煤矿和两台刻录机；同时匹配时优先显示 234.9。未匹配字段为空，本查询不判定上传是否成功。
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN a.channel_id LIKE '%150622000013200031%' THEN '利民' WHEN a.channel_id LIKE '%150622000013200063%' THEN '黄白茨' WHEN a.channel_id LIKE '%150622000013200096%' THEN '骆驼山' WHEN a.channel_id LIKE '%150622000013200084%' THEN '公务素' WHEN a.channel_id LIKE '%150622000013200075%' THEN '路天' WHEN a.channel_id LIKE '%150622000013200052%' THEN '五虎山' WHEN a.channel_id LIKE '%150622000013200040%' THEN '老石旦' END AS `煤矿名称`, a.name AS `视频名称`, COALESCE(b.id, c.id) AS `通道编码`, CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN '234.9刻录机' WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN '234.10刻录机' END AS `刻录机来源`, a.channel_id AS `视频编码`, a.address AS `地址` FROM `wvp_device_channel` AS a LEFT JOIN `9video` AS b ON a.channel_id = b.name LEFT JOIN `10video` AS c ON a.channel_id = c.name ORDER BY `煤矿名称`, b.id
